for whom: Istanbul police, in a drug operation across 14 provinces
how the system's work was checked: Police reviewed the reports and used them in field investigations.
the system's part: By the police account relayed by Anadolu Agency, AVCI infiltrated closed messaging groups and decoded slang and coded language. It preserved messages by recording group traffic before users deleted it, linked profiles through IP analysis, and mapped group relationships. That work produced the suspects and groups targeted on 10 February. Police and courts carried out the detentions, referrals and remands. The sources include no independent evaluation of the system. No official is quoted on how many of the 325 were identified by AVCI and how many by conventional work. No developer beyond the police's own software team is named in the sources.
human oversight: Police reviewed the reports and used them in field investigations. Officers detained suspects, and courts decided remand.
what the sources leave unknown: The police do not say how many suspects AVCI identified and how many came from other investigative work. The counts differ by date: 305 detained on 10 February, 324 remanded by 13 February and 325 detained and remanded in the report of 6 April 2026. No charges or convictions have been reported, and the sources show no measure of any reduction in drug-related harm and no error rate for the system.

benefit: TrailGuard AI alerts lead to arrest of 39 poachers in Similipal
for whom: Similipal Tiger Reserve staff, in arresting 39 armed poachers
how the system's work was checked: Forest officers assessed the alerts and coordinated about 24 hours of searching across three ranges before the group surrendered.
human oversight: Forest officers assessed the alerts and coordinated about 24 hours of searching across three ranges before the group surrendered.
what must hold for it to happen again: Cameras remain concealed and powered. Alerts reach field teams in near real time.
what the sources leave unknown: The camera alerts and arrests are reported, but the sources include no official records to confirm the sequence of events or the charges. An arrest or a refusal of bail is not a conviction, and the reserve has published no measure of a fall in poaching or in deaths of wildlife.

benefit: SPIA tracks a stolen car across Teresina within hours
for whom: Piauí’s police, in recovering a stolen car
how the system's work was checked: Operators passed the system's location alerts in real time to police teams, who set up the interception and made the arrests.
human oversight: Operators passed the system's location alerts in real time to police teams, who set up the interception and made the arrests.
what the sources leave unknown: The benefit rests on one incident told by the Secretaria de Segurança Pública do Piauí and relayed by g1 Piauí. Neither document describes how SPIA recognizes vehicles, how often its alerts are right or how many thefts it has helped resolve. No outside body checked the account.

benefit: Kipo Analyzer eases the review of abuse images by Lower Saxony police
for whom: Lower Saxony’s police, in reviewing child sexual abuse material
how the system's work was checked: The tools pre-select and classify seized images, and investigators evaluate the material.
human oversight: The tools pre-select and classify seized images, and investigators evaluate the material. The report describes the software as supporting the police in assessing images, not as deciding anything itself.
what the sources leave unknown: The auditor's finding rests on the Interior Ministry's evaluation of January 2025, in which users rated the software as easing their work. The report gives no figure for time saved, accuracy or missed images. It states that pre-sorting lowers psychological strain but does not measure it.

benefit: London police explore AI that grades abuse images to find victims faster
for whom: The Metropolitan Police, in sorting child sexual abuse imagery to find victims
how the system's work was checked: Specialist officers would retain decision-making responsibility and oversight throughout the proposed workflow.
human oversight: Specialist officers would retain decision-making responsibility and oversight throughout the proposed workflow.
what must hold for it to happen again: Legal and ethical frameworks for processing the material. Human decision-making retained.
what the sources leave unknown: The force announced only that it is exploring and testing possible tools. Its counts of safeguarded children and investigated offenses describe existing police work, and the tool that reviews 641,000 messages is a separate system. No outcome from the proposed AI for image triage has been established.

benefit: A man pleads guilty after OpenAI refers his threats to the FBI
for whom: Police investigating stalking, after a threat referral
how the system's work was checked: OpenAI’s general policy calls for human review of serious threats before a possible referral to law enforcement.
human oversight: OpenAI’s general policy calls for human review of serious threats before a possible referral to law enforcement. In this case, police independently compared the disclosed messages with threats that the victim had preserved.
what the sources leave unknown: No source reproduces the complete affidavit, the plea order, the complete ChatGPT messages or OpenAI's disclosure. The classifier, the trigger and the reviewer decisions in this case are unknown, and no source shows that an attack would otherwise have occurred.

benefit: Brazil's audit court finds Galileu drafts reliable in labor cases
for whom: Judges at TRT-4, a Brazilian labor court
how the system's work was checked: Federal Court of Accounts auditors tested it on 50 real cases and confirmed each suspected hallucination.
human oversight: The judge reviews and signs every draft that Galileu produces. In the audit, the auditors confirmed each suspected hallucination themselves.
what the sources leave unknown: The TCU's fidelity test covered 50 real, non-confidential lawsuits, with reference lists of claims and facts built by one AI model and reviewed by another. Its figures describe drafts, not errors proven in judgments or actual harm. The bias tests changed only gender and occupation. TRT-4 itself had shown no fidelity or reproducibility test results for Galileu.

benefit: AI cameras identify 18 teenagers gathering with weapons in Việt Trì
for whom: Phú Thọ provincial police, in identifying teenagers gathering to fight
how the system's work was checked: not in the sources
human oversight: Police combined camera evidence with information from residents, then verified identities, summoned the teenagers, and investigated individual conduct.
what the sources leave unknown: The police give no matching logs, no independent check of identities and no handling of false matches. The summons and the reported admissions do not show that violence was prevented. Thanh Niên reports that two groups fought at the Hội Thịnh roundabout that night. Whether the 10 people charged are among the 18 identified by camera is unknown.

benefit: OpenAI flag leads Brazilian police to hold a father a day early
for whom: Espírito Santo police, in detaining a father before a stated date
how the system's work was checked: OpenAI's automated classifiers and human reviewers flagged the messages, and the company chose to refer the account to the FBI.
human oversight: OpenAI's automated classifiers and human reviewers flagged the messages, and the company chose to refer the account to the FBI. The FBI and the Ministry of Justice's CyberLab passed it to the state police, who obtained warrants before the arrest. After the arrest the police examined whether he had taken concrete steps toward the plans. A court freed him on habeas corpus on 13 August 2026.
what must hold for it to happen again: The user discloses the plan to the assistant rather than keeping it offline. The vendor's reviewers judge the threat credible and imminent and choose referral rather than only an account ban.
what the sources leave unknown: The referral and the arrest are observed protective actions, but they are no proof that a killing would otherwise have occurred. The suspect denied intent and was later released under restrictions. The assistant's replies and the relative contributions of automated detection and human review remain unknown.

benefit: AI-based CCTV tracking traces two missing students in 90 minutes
for whom: Nandyal police, in tracing two missing students
how the system's work was checked: Police officers followed the students' movements on CCTV footage with the tools and went to find them.
human oversight: Police officers followed the students' movements on CCTV footage with the tools and went to find them. The article does not say whether anyone checked the tools' tracking.
what the sources leave unknown: The article rests on the police account of one search. It does not name the system or its maker, say how the tools work, or give a search time without them. It does not say what risk the two students faced. Officials withheld their identities, so no account from them exists.

benefit: Police facial recognition vans in Huddersfield lead to three arrests
for whom: West Yorkshire Police, in three arrests at a live facial recognition deployment
how the system's work was checked: Officers reviewed each alert before intervening and decided whether an arrest or a check on compliance with an order was warranted.
human oversight: Officers reviewed each alert before intervening and decided whether an arrest or a check on compliance with an order was warranted.
what the sources leave unknown: The force's records do not measure missed matches. No conviction or specific harm prevented has been reported. The accuracy figures of the National Physical Laboratory come from deployments by other forces and do not cover West Yorkshire Police.

benefit: Bobbi chatbot helps Thames Valley Police handle non-emergency contact
for whom: Thames Valley Police, in handling non-emergency demand
how the system's work was checked: Bobbi answers non-emergency questions online from approved knowledge articles and hands a conversation to an operator when needed.
human oversight: Bobbi answers non-emergency questions online from approved knowledge articles and hands a conversation to an operator when needed. Salesforce states that it resolves 75% of conversations without an operator.
what the sources leave unknown: The inspectorate mentions Bobbi in one sentence and gives no figures. The usage, resolution and cost figures come from Salesforce, the platform's maker, in a customer story. The satisfaction score rests on feedback from users. The return on investment and the staff hours reclaimed are forecasts.

benefit: Paraná court upholds nine IAT forest cases built on MapBiomas Alerta
for whom: Paraná's environment agency and courts, against forest clearing
how the system's work was checked: MapBiomas analysts validate each alert on satellite images.
human oversight: IAT analysts set each alert against other satellite images before issuing notices, and the court found that human operators compared before-and-after images. Judges decided each appeal.
what the sources leave unknown: No decision measured the accuracy of the MapBiomas alerts or of the IAT satellite reports. The courts relied on the legal presumption that agency documents are true. In the Dois Vizinhos appeal the farmer sought no expert evidence. The interim rulings are provisional, and the habeas corpus majority said the evidence merits further examination. The dissenting judges called the IAT reports indirect and one-sided.

benefit: Anthropic flag on a shooting threat leads to a Florida arrest
for whom: Lee County deputies, in a threat referral
how the system's work was checked: Reviewers assessed the messages before making the referral.
the system's part: The platform's monitoring flagged the two messages automatically, and a human review team judged their severity and referred them to law enforcement. The sources leave open whether a classifier or a keyword rule raised the flag. Reporters identify the chatbot as Claude, and court records show that the user told the detective that she used Perplexity.
human oversight: not in the sources
what must hold for it to happen again: The referral must identify a real person and a real risk. The Lee County Sheriff's Office told reporters it does not count tips from Anthropic. No public figures exist on how often such referrals are made or prove unfounded. The disclosure must stay within the emergency exception of the Stored Communications Act. An EFF attorney told Straight Arrow News “there is always the risk of over-reporting”.
what the sources leave unknown: Anthropic has not disclosed whether a classifier or a keyword rule flagged the messages. Only reporters name Claude as the platform. Prosecutors had not filed a formal charge by 8 October 2026. No public figures show how often such referrals are made or prove unfounded.

benefit: Arizona court declines to raise a 70-80% recall target for TAR
for whom: The defendants in an Arizona federal class action
how the system's work was checked: The court found no evidence that a recall target of 70% to 80% was deficient.
human oversight: The defendants said that manual review after TAR, to raise recall, had delayed production, so people reviewed the output before documents were produced. The court required them to share validation metrics, including recall.
what the sources leave unknown: The court ruled while the review was still under way, so no achieved recall is reported. It found only that the evidence did not show a 70–80% target to be deficient. The plaintiffs may raise recall again if highly relevant documents prove missing.

benefit: Artificial intelligence tools and others lift Dyfed-Powys productivity
for whom: Dyfed-Powys Police, in its use of digital tools
how the system's work was checked: not in the sources
human oversight: The report does not say whether officers or staff review the automated triage of safeguarding risks, the firearms licensing checks or the file processing for lower-harm crime before decisions take effect.
what the sources leave unknown: The report names no AI product and gives no figure for the gains. It credits artificial intelligence together with cloud storage and data analytics, so the share of AI cannot be separated. It does not say which automated areas use AI. The risk-identification system is still in development, and its benefit is stated as what it should do.

benefit: WA Police live facial recognition trial leads to 122 arrests
for whom: Western Australia Police, in a live facial recognition trial
how the system's work was checked: Officers acted on the alerts and made the 122 arrests.
human oversight: Officers acted on the alerts and made the 122 arrests. The commissioner said that officers engaged with each person wrongly flagged by the nine incorrect alerts.
what the sources leave unknown: The force had not yet published its evaluation of the trial. The figures are its own, and none compares policing with and without the system.

benefit: Hubei prosecutors' AI case system cuts days of file review to hours
for whom: Hubei’s prosecutors, in handling 21 kinds of offense
how the system's work was checked: The system assists prosecutors, who decide.
human oversight: The system assists prosecutors, who decide. In one drug-trafficking prosecution it flagged two abnormal transactions, prosecutors followed the lead and established further offenses, which the court upheld.
what the sources leave unknown: The figures come from the procuratorates as the newspaper relays them, and no outside evaluation separates the system's part from prosecutors' work.

benefit: Facial recognition helps Minas Gerais police find 2,500 wanted people
for whom: Minas Gerais’s military police, in locating people wanted by the courts
how the system's work was checked: Officers made the arrests after alerts from the control center.
human oversight: Officers made the arrests after alerts from the control center. The report does not say whether anyone verified the matches before officers approached the people flagged.
what the sources leave unknown: The figures are the state's own. The report gives no count of false alerts or of people stopped in error, and it does not separate the tool's part from officers' work.
